dataset: Cloudflare Radar Outage Center – outage annotations (Radar API)
description: Internet outage annotations curated by the Cloudflare Radar team: where connectivity was disrupted, how broad the disruption was (nationwide, regional, single network or platform), its scope, the likely cause and the start and end time.

coverage.geographic: Worldwide; one entry per affected country (entries without a location, e.g. cloud-platform outages, are kept as non-geographic bulletins).
coverage.temporal: Annotations of the last 7 days per fetch; the Outage Center archive starts in 2022.

updateCadence.upstream: Entries are added and amended manually by Cloudflare, typically hours after a disruption begins; end times are filled in later.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
envVars.description: Cloudflare API token with the Account → Radar: Read permission, sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

auth.setup: Sign in to a (free) Cloudflare account, open My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token → Create Custom Token, add the permission Account → Radar → Read, create the token and set it as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0)
license.notes: Stated on https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/ : "Data available via Radar API endpoints is made available under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license." Non-commercial use only, attribution to Cloudflare Radar required. The linked reference URLs point to third-party pages with their own terms.

limitations: Annotations are curated by hand: coverage is selective (notable disruptions that Cloudflare observed and could corroborate), entries appear with a delay and may be amended or get an end time later.
The cause is Cloudflare's assessment of the likely cause based on publicly available information, not an official finding.
Location is the affected country (alpha-2); regional and network-level outages are drawn at the country label point, with the affected area or network only described in the scope text.
Only the last 7 days are requested; whether a still-ongoing annotation that began earlier is returned by the dateRange filter is not documented.
Requires a free Cloudflare account and API token; the Cloudflare API allows 1,200 requests per five minutes per user (this adapter makes 2 per hour).
confidenceNotes: These are human-curated outage annotations from the Cloudflare Radar Outage Center, based on Cloudflare's own traffic observations and public reporting, not automatic anomaly detections. Confidence (0.85 with a linked public reference, 0.75 without) and severity (from the outage type and duration) are assigned by this application and listed as derived; the upstream type and cause wording is kept verbatim.

retention.note: Outage records are kept for 60 days after they ended, then purged.

layers.name: Internet outages (Cloudflare Radar)
layers.description: Curated Internet outage annotations from the Cloudflare Radar Outage Center, drawn at the affected country: outage type, scope, likely cause, affected networks and duration.
